entries.explanation: Reports the module administrator, not a charter holder or proof of every permission.
entries.units: Addresses/bytes are identities or payloads; booleans are flags, not monetary quantities. Strings/arrays retain standard dynamic ABI encoding.
limitations: Publisher interface evidence, not independent implementation/source-bytecode correspondence, current target selection or authority to sign/submit.
